caption:
Does gua sha or facial massage really lift your face?

Facial massage may temporarily increase local blood flow and change puffiness. Current evidence does not establish a predictable, permanent facelift.

That does not make the ritual useless. It means temporary de-puffing and structural lifting are different claims. If you have active irritation, bruising, or a recent injectable or thread treatment, ask your clinician before applying pressure.

Send this to the friend with a gua sha drawer.

General education only.

first_comment: Roller, gua sha, or just your hands — which one do you actually use? And be honest: does the change still show after lunch?
